sections.heading: We lead with *outcomes*, not offerings
sections.description: Start with your business requirements. Each play below suggests a starting deliverable; scope and acceptance criteria are agreed for your engagement.

plays.title: AI Code Assurance
plays.trigger: AI-generated code increases delivery speed and assurance risk.
plays.outcome: Quality and security gates across CI/CD for AI-written change. Start with a CI/CD assurance-gate map.

plays.title: Modernisation & Programme Assurance
plays.trigger: Complex migration and customisation create regression and integration risk.
plays.outcome: Migration readiness, automated regression, integration rebuild and security validation. Start with a migration readiness and dependency map.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Modernisation & Integration Toolkit, testoriumz, Release Assurance Packs

plays.title: Regulated Cyber Readiness
plays.trigger: Regulated industries need continuous evidence, not point-in-time reports.
plays.outcome: Continuous exposure validation, control mapping and remediation evidence. Start with an exposure and control-evidence baseline.

plays.title: Intelligent Operations
plays.trigger: Cost-to-serve pressure creates demand for process intelligence and automation.
plays.outcome: Discover, redesign and automate work across process and customer channels. Start with a workflow and exception map.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Intelligent Workflow Automation Framework, testoriumz, Cyber-Safe Delivery

plays.title: Capability Centres with Embedded IP
plays.trigger: Organisations need scalable delivery capacity with stronger governance and automation.
plays.outcome: Build-operate-transfer GCCs with quality, security and engineering IP embedded. Start with a capability and ownership blueprint.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Delivery Governance, Quality Engineering IP, Cyber-Safe Delivery

sections.heading: Flexible *commercial models*

items.title: Fixed Price
items.description: Defined scope and outcome delivered against agreed milestones and acceptance criteria.
items.bullets: Best for – Well-defined projects, migrations, discrete builds.

items.title: Time & Materials
items.description: Flexible delivery where scope evolves, with transparent rates and governance.
items.bullets: Best for – Discovery, evolving roadmaps, co-development.

items.title: Managed Service
items.description: Ongoing service with agreed service levels, governance and continuous improvement.
items.bullets: Best for – Application management, managed quality, managed security.

items.title: Dedicated Team
items.description: Persistent squads or specialist teams aligned to your priorities and ways of working.
items.bullets: Best for – Product engineering, sustained capacity, capability centres (GCC).

items.title: Outcome-Based
items.description: Commercials linked to measurable business or operational outcomes, where these can be agreed and evidenced.
items.bullets: Best for – Assurance, exposure closure, resolution-rate engagements.

sections.description: Choose commercials to fit the scope, ownership and acceptance criteria. Delivery and software licensing are separate decisions.
sections.note: Linkfields products are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without a Linkfields services engagement.

sections.heading: How the portfolios work *together*
sections.description: Illustrative journey: modernise an application with release assurance and security validation, connect data and AI, and scale teams. The capabilities below support the work; this is not a client case.

items.title: Services depth
items.description: Digital Transformation leads application change. Enterprise Platforms and Data & AI connect processes and data; Cyber Security contributes validation. Agree the lead portfolio and delivery owner.

items.title: Proprietary software
items.description: Linkworks supports application change, testoriumz supplies test evidence, and VectorX and VajraX contribute security validation. Select software for the scope rather than assuming every product is required.

items.title: Reusable accelerators
items.description: Modernisation, workflow automation and Cyber-Safe Delivery IP support implementation. Agree which artefacts are reused or tailored for the programme.

items.title: Integrated delivery
items.description: Talent Advisory & GCC adds specialists, managed teams or a capability centre with embedded IP. Agree work ownership, governance and acceptance across services, software and teams.
